byte_scope: Application datagrams plus framed event/action streams. Excludes handshake, TLS/QUIC/UDP/IP headers and retransmissions. Byte counters are sampled across the common measurement window; each client reports its actual counter-sampling interval in elapsed_us. Ramp-up and drain are excluded.

environment.network: isolated loopback namespace, no external access
environment.host: shared Linux machine; four logical CPUs
environment.interpretation: Contended shared-host baseline. Concurrent builds overlapped the opening portion; other host workloads were uncontrolled.

percentile_method: Nearest rank for per-client p50/median and p95. Tick-error percentiles are bounds from log2 microsecond histogram bins.
health_counter_scope: Snapshot/error/walk counts cover the connection lifetime. Byte counts and their elapsed_us cover only the common measurement window.
